results.title: Tungsten - Wikipedia
results.snippet: Tungsten is a chemical element; it has symbol W.Tungsten occurs in many alloys, which have numerous applications, including incandescent light bulb filaments, X-ray tubes, electrodes in gas tungsten arc welding, superalloys, and radiation shielding.

results.title: Tungsten, chemical element that is an exceptionally strong metal.
results.snippet: The chemical symbol for tungsten is W, and its atomic number is 74.Tungsten is a strong, refractory metal used to increase hardness and strength in steels and in lamp filaments. It has a high melting point of 3,410 °C (6,170 °F) and is highly conductive to electricity.

results.snippet: The chemical symbol for tungsten is W which stands for Wolfram. The name came from medieval German smelters who found that tin ores containing tungsten had a much lower yield.

results.title: Tungsten
results.snippet: The word wolframite and the chemical symbol for tungsten (W) both come from the mineral's original German name wolf rahm, meaning wolf foam.
